name: cost-baseline
description: Cost baseline entries are retired only after a complete, unfiltered, serial run, through the real CostCompleteness hooks.

actions.init: Create actual pytest Config/Session, CostCompleteness, and two-entry baseline file.
actions.skipOrDeselect: Passed pytest.TestReport phases followed by pytest_deselected with a pytest.Item.
actions.earlySuccessfulExit: One actual completed TestReport sequence; finish input says two collected tests.
actions.testFailure: Actual failed call report and passed teardown; final TESTS_FAILED status.
actions.distributedRun: Instantiate with Config.option.numprocesses=2; actual measured TestReport sequence.
actions.completeRun: Actual passed TestReport sequence with obligation_cost_contract property.
actions.finishUpdate: Call real CostCompleteness.pytest_sessionfinish with actual pytest.Session inputs.
actions.inspect: Observe baseline via load_cost_baseline and real plugin visited/finished fields; no repeated hook.

mutants.name: shipped-389c5bb
mutants.description: The exact CostCompleteness.pytest_sessionfinish shipped at 389c5bb, before the fix: update mode prunes every unmeasured entry at session end, even after a failed collection, filter or crash

mutants.name: ignore-deselection
mutants.description: Deselected tests are not recorded as incomplete, so a filtered run can retire entries its deselected tests would have measured

mutants.name: disable-retirement
mutants.description: Pruning never happens, so a complete run cannot retire a contract no test measures any more

bugs_found.summary: Running with OBLIGATION_COST_BASELINE=update after an incomplete run (failed collection, deselection, early exit, failure, collect-only or xdist) deleted every baseline entry that run did not measure
bugs_found.found_by: the historical audit model (audit.qnt, pinned to 389c5bb): baselineDeletionWitnessTest reaches the deletion after a collection error

limits: Unitizes actual pytest hook entrypoints and report transport, not a full pytest collection/execution loop.
Existing test_costs.py subprocess tests retain real lifecycle and real xdist worker-loss coverage.
Two baseline contracts, at most two collected items; measured contract properties are report inputs, not SQL measurement proof.
Explicit caller path omissions/custom collector exclusions remain outside completeness inference.

shipped-389c5bb runs history/sessionfinish-389c5bb.py.txt, the pre-fix hook copied verbatim from 389c5bb and pinned by SHA-256 in cost_baseline_adapter.py; it replaces the earlier hand-written unconditional-prune control, which reproduced the same rule.
